selected_branches.branch: Person parking in a posted City-vehicle space

law_text: The City Council may designate parking spaces upon City streets or in City parking facilities for the parking of City vehicles. It is unlawful to park a vehicle other than a City vehicle in any such space that has been duly posted or marked.
